bio: I'm a Senior QA Engineer at Betsson in Estonia, with 10+ years across high-stakes environments — from mission-critical Brazilian Air Force systems to iGaming platforms serving thousands of stakeholders. I work the full SDLC: shaping requirements, automating browser and API tests, mentoring teams toward releases that don't need crossed fingers.
extras: ISTQB Foundation Level certified. Recently completed Full-Stack (IBM) and Web Development (University of Michigan) specialisations. Currently studying mobile testing with Appium, Android Studio, and Xcode.
